data.narrative:
David Energy is a Series A climate and energy company founded by James McGinniss, Brian Maxwell, and Ahmed Salman. The valuation analysis draws on a sector universe of one public comparable (LNZA) and eight private peers in Climate & Energy, including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix.

Given the absence of sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow peer set, the Peer-Median method is not applicable. The Stage-Progression method is therefore the primary triangulation tool. Using total capital raised of $64.4M as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A progression yields an implied valuation of $128.8M.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $109M (low) to $148M (high), with a median point of $129M. This range reflects ±15% variance around the stage-progression result. Key uncertainties include the absence of tightly matched peer benchmarks and reliance on a single applicable method. The narrow Climate & Energy peer set at comparable stages limits confidence in market validation. Investors should treat this estimate as directional pending access to transaction-level data from more adjacent-stage companies or clarification of company-specific unit economics and market penetration metrics.
